info.title: CF Agent Hub — Proposed Native HTTP API
info.description: Pre-implementation design baseline dated 2026-10-23; contract revision 0.1. All operations are proposed and require implementation verification. No running service, SDK, protocol certification or exactly-once external execution is claimed. docs/http-api.md defines authorization, pagination, idempotency and concurrency semantics. docs/limits.md owns numerical operational limits. All JSON writes reject unknown fields and enforce UTF-8 envelope limits. Runtime-bound writes additionally require X-Runtime-Token proof; native bearer alone is insufficient. R1 amendment r1-foundation-1 specifies identity, settings, audit and protected recovery contracts; implementation remains pending. Portable contracts stay 0.1; deployment is 0.2.

post.description: Atomically claim ready task, enforce current grant, assignment, work-role eligibility and WIP, create active run and larger task-local fence. Credential must bind the runtime agent; runtime must be live. Native bearer AND X-Runtime-Token must validate to the same credential/agent/workspace; proof runtime must match the request or stored run. IDs and fence are not authentication. Reject outcome_unknown and retry_exhausted holds. There is no hold-clear or retry-budget extension command in this baseline; reconciled reviewed replacement work is required. Atomically persist trusted retry-safety policy classification with the claim/audit before execution. On expiry default to backlog+outcome_unknown; only preexisting replay-safe classification permits bounded automatic retry. Stale runtime cannot mutate or assert safety after losing authority.

get.summary: Search authorized tasks, message bodies and artifact metadata
get.description: search:read plus tasks:read/messages:read/artifacts:read for each returned kind and current project/thread access. Message participation or human messages:review is still required. Normalize text/query to NFC and compare literal case-sensitive substrings. Authorize before snippets and pagination; artifact metadata only, never object bytes. Globally distinct searchable IDs ordered by immutable (created_at,id), fixed initial high-water. Authorized-only lookahead determines continuation from the last returned authorized hit, never a hidden scanned frontier. No total or successful empty progress page. Preserve hard 2000 examined-candidate cap; if lookahead or high-water exhaustion cannot be established within the budget, fail entire request with generic503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, no partial data or cursor. This explicitly supersedes older empty-filtered continuation requirements. Successful page shape must not change merely because hidden records are inserted within feasible budget; status/timing availability leakage remains, not constant-time or total noninterference. Physical SQLite/index/authorization-work proof remains required before activation; output LIMIT is not that proof. Shared padded/fixed-width AES-GCM cursor binds workspace/principal/lane/credential/session, operation, normalized query, kind, limit, sort, high-water, authority epoch and restore incarnation; retain absolute3600-second expiry and2048-byte token bound. Reauthorize after decode and encode before final synchronous projection. Proven message truncation floor applies only when messages are searched; never invalidate task/artifact-only search using the message floor.

Preview stores a bounded plan expiring exactly 15 minutes after trusted creation, with touched versions retained internally. Apply returns the existing ProfileView (ProfileData), not a new profile shape.

get.description: Specified R2 read contract; not an available R1 endpoint. In one transaction recheck current task/project and complete artifact visibility before selection. Seek by immutable internal submission sequence under a fixed ceiling. Continuation uses the last returned authorized sequence and exists only for another authorized result; hidden-only suffixes never produce a continuation. Complete canonical results only. No physical scan bound follows from LIMIT; activation requires a demonstrated bounded authorization/query plan. A work-budget failure returns no partial data or progress cursor. See ADR 0008 for byte limits, absolute cursor expiry, authority/restore binding and residual timing risks.

200.description: Currently authorized immutable results, with authorized-only lookahead; hidden-only history is an empty terminal page.

500.description: Unexpected internal failure; sanitized error only, no partial history or progress cursor.

post.description: Proposed human-only import contract, not enabled in R1. Recheck verified current human, workspace, owning principal, scopes and every relevant resource before preview/read/apply/replay; possession of import ID or digest grants nothing. Deny generically if an immutable saved preview/report can no longer be disclosed; never redact it into a different plan. Mapping visibility precedes classification. POST requires exact origin, CSRF and idempotency. Apply revalidates original references and mapping snapshots and atomically creates only reviewed Backlog tasks, mappings, provenance/report, event/audit and sanitized replay. Source text and source_ref are inert; no fetch or imported authority. Changed source never overwrites local work. Enforce actual raw 65,536-byte request bound before decoding, validate ImportEnvelope, then validate each ImportRow. Strict ImportBatch represents wholly valid input; an invalid row is a rejected preview row, not necessarily an envelope failure.

ProfilePreview.description: field is a JSON Pointer into canonical merged profile. Arrays <=200; entire UTF-8 response envelope <=65536 bytes. Reject overflow, never truncate. Stale revision409; malformed shapes/duplicates use normal validation errors.

MessageNotification.description: Immutable notification intent. The receiver durably deduplicates delivery_id and fetches authoritative content with its own current credential; transport acceptance does not acknowledge or execute the message.

CatalogPlan.description: Persisted catalog preview, distinct from advisory profile preview. At most 200 affected entities combined across affected_task_ids and affected_agent_ids; reject overflow, never truncate. The combined limit is a semantic constraint, not enforced by the per-array JSON Schema limits alone. expires_at is exactly 900 seconds (15 minutes) after trusted server creation time. Store touched entity versions internally, not in this public DTO. Apply checks current profile revision against both the request and stored plan, all touched entity versions, current human authority and plan expiry using transaction time; stale or expired plans conflict. IDs and references must belong to the current workspace. These contracts do not implement runtime enforcement.

ImportBatch.title: R2 import batch input contract
ImportBatch.description: Strict shape of a completely valid import batch. Raw request bytes are separately limited to 65,536 before decoding. For partial rejection, validate ImportEnvelope first, then each ImportRow independently. Strict root failure alone must not reject a preview request. Shape validation grants no authority and does not resolve current references or duplicate external IDs.

ImportEnvelope.description: Closed envelope admission only; row validity is reported separately. Null, primitive and unknown-field rows are not silently accepted as valid ImportRows.

source_ref.description: Inert provenance text. Never fetched or interpreted as executable authority.

ImportProvenance.description: Inert provenance of this import attempt, including current batch source_revision for unchanged rows. source_sha256 hashes the canonical complete ImportRow, excluding batch revision metadata. It does not change local task state or confer authority. Source references are never fetched.

ImportPreviewRow.description: Every rejected row suppresses external_id, task_id and provenance. Absent and inaccessible references share INVALID_REFERENCE. Mapping visibility is checked before unchanged/conflict classification; inaccessible mapping targets are rejected, not disclosed as conflicts.

ImportReportRow.description: Every rejected row suppresses external_id, task_id and provenance. Absent and inaccessible references share INVALID_REFERENCE. Mapping visibility is checked before unchanged/conflict classification; inaccessible mapping targets are rejected, not disclosed as conflicts.

ImportPreview.description: Immutable version-1 plan. Ordered row indices are contiguous from zero; rows.length and disposition counts partition received exactly. Expires exactly 900 seconds after internally stored trusted creation time. preview_sha256 is lowercase SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonicalJson of this public object excluding preview_sha256 (sorted object keys, array order retained). This public digest does not hash omitted source bodies: id separately binds immutable original source rows/hashes and mapping/reference version snapshots server-side. Internal snapshots cannot be replaced under the same id. No tasks or mappings are created by preview. Every disclosed duplicate external-ID group is entirely conflict/DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_ID; malformed or inaccessible rows remain generic rejected/null identifiers.

ImportApplyRequest.description: Requires exact version and preview digest. False with any conflict/rejected row yields INVALID_STATE. Expired previews yield INVALID_STATE; digest/version mismatch or any changed mapping/reference snapshot yields VERSION_CONFLICT for the whole apply. Recheck current authority before replay and apply; no partial transaction on failure. True only admits the reviewed create rows, never overwrites conflicts or bypasses invalid references.

ImportReport.description: Applied version-2 immutable report. Preview create becomes report created; all other dispositions retain meaning. Counts partition received and match contiguous ordered rows. Created and unchanged rows include current-attempt inert provenance, with task/import/external IDs consistent with their report and input. All valid new source states map to unassigned Backlog with no run, result, approval, credential or grant. Failed apply leaves preview and task/mapping state unchanged.

Import.description: Closed GET union discriminated by import_version: 1 preview or 2 applied report. Current authorization and visibility precede any projection; deny rather than redact immutable rows/counts/digest.

Forbidden.description: Wrong actor kind, scope or policy refusal.

NotFound.description: Resource missing or hidden by workspace/resource isolation.

Conflict.description: Version, idempotency, state, ownership or eligibility conflict.

Gone.description: Cursor or pending approval expired; re-read and reconcile.

TooLarge.description: Envelope, message or artifact byte/count bound exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a potentially useful retry; not an authorization to repeat external effects.

Unavailable.description: Transient dependency unavailable; reconcile ambiguous mutations before retry.
